Ava / team —

Attached is the initial packet (see filenames below). Quick answers to your clarifications are inline in the cover note:

- Customer-portal-initiated erasures: We have one anonymized example of a portal-initiated erasure request. It shows the request id, orchestration job id, and the subsequent runtime purge steps (redacted). This is included in "anonymized_erasure_trace_sample.txt". We also include notes in the playbook describing differences between portal-initiated and operator-initiated paths.

- Backups & tombstone handling: Our archival policy marks objects with tombstones and sets lifecycle transitions to archive after X days. Tombstones are preserved in metadata; archives are immutable snapshots that cannot be altered post-archive, but we do honor deletion requests by removing pointers and ensuring future restores exclude erased objects. The auditor asked for the policy excerpt — included as a section in redwood-deletion-playbook.pdf and a separate excerpt file "backup_tombstone_excerpt.txt".
